items.name: 1,000 simultaneous realtime players
items.detail: Topology/capacity plan + 1,000 session burst ready; requires >=5 real nodes and certified shared state backend.

items.name: 1,000-player chaos/failover
items.detail: 80-client hard-crash recovery passes locally; 1,000-player chaos requires real multi-node staging.

items.name: 6–24h soak
items.detail: 24h-capable fail-closed soak harness included; long real-infrastructure run must be executed externally.

items.name: Production infrastructure
items.detail: Kubernetes topology, drain, readiness, HPA/PDB/network policy prepared; provider provisioning/TLS/DNS external.

items.name: Production database / DR
items.detail: Local SQLite restore drill passes; multi-node is blocked until shared transactional state backend + offsite restore evidence.

items.name: DDoS / edge protection
items.detail: Rate limits/backpressure in app; provider edge/WAF/DDoS must be configured externally.

items.name: Monitoring / alerting
items.detail: Prometheus rules and private metrics included; real alert delivery route must be proven.

items.name: Admin / GM operations
items.detail: Auditable offline admin/GM tooling, status/economy views and runbook included; production drill remains evidence-gated.

items.name: External security test
items.detail: Local deterministic security audit 225/225 + fuzz 320/320; external staging assessment remains gated.

items.name: Physical iOS devices
items.detail: Device matrix policy/runbook prepared; requires real devices.

items.name: Physical Android devices
items.detail: Device matrix policy/runbook prepared; requires real devices.

items.name: Signed AAB / iOS archive
items.detail: Build/signing gates prepared; requires publisher signing credentials/toolchains.

items.name: App Store Connect / Play Console
items.detail: Store requirements/checklists ready; account-side configuration external.

items.name: Production push
items.detail: Push outbox/provider adapter prepared; APNs/FCM credentials and delivery proof external.

items.name: Production IAP
items.detail: Commerce is off by default; entitlement adapters/gates exist and become mandatory when enabled.

items.name: Sandbox purchases/refunds
items.detail: Commerce-off release waives IAP evidence; becomes required when commerceEnabled=true.

items.name: Published legal/support pages
items.detail: Templates and renderer are ready; final publisher identity + HTTPS hosting external.

items.name: Privacy/GDPR production review
items.detail: Privacy data map and deletion controls included; final production/legal review external.

items.name: Nyrathen trademark clearance
items.detail: Preliminary screening note included; formal DPMA/EUIPO/TMview/professional clearance external.

items.name: Age ratings / UGC questionnaires
items.detail: Preparation included; final Apple/Google/IARC submission external.

items.name: TestFlight / Play closed beta
items.detail: Beta/device matrix prepared; real testers/store channels external.

items.name: Crash / ANR beta review
items.detail: Operational telemetry gates prepared; real beta crash/ANR data required.

items.name: Economy balancing with real players
items.detail: Synthetic economy health passes; real-player inflation/progression review external.

items.name: Initial LiveOps content
items.detail: Original Emberwatch launch seed, mission tree, Crucible and reward track included.

items.name: Support / moderation process
items.detail: Support/moderation runbook and audit tooling included; live drill external-evidence gated.

items.name: Observed canary / rollback
items.detail: Canary controller and rollback policy implemented; observed production-like traffic external.

items.name: 2k / 5k / 10k capacity
items.detail: Planner/topologies implemented; real benchmark evidence required for each tier.

items.name: Final release candidate freeze
items.detail: v5.4 internal RC will be frozen by package manifest + clean-unpack verification; signed store RC remains external.
